steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Compare. Each clause is matched to its fallback position. A clause that moves uncapped cost is flagged.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

outcome.verdict: 2 clauses move risk to the organisation

findings.title: Termination right favours only the supplier
findings.fix: Ask for a mutual termination right

findings.title: Automatic renewal with no notice route
findings.fix: Add a notice route before signing

findings.title: Uncapped liability moved to the organisation
findings.fix: Cap the liability at the fee

outcome.notChecked: Whether a clause is enforceable or what it means in law. Counsel decides.
